slots.jd.remodeling.about:
About us and the job
Rowan Remodeling is an owner-run remodeling contractor in Eugene, OR. We rework kitchens, baths and other rooms, and we take care to do the job right the first time. We are looking for a journeyman carpenter to work on site with our crew, handling carpentry from framing through finish. You will work directly with the owner and always know who to go to with a question.
slots.jd.remodeling.duties:
What the job involves
- Keep the site safe, clean and organized for the crew and the homeowner
- Order lumber and materials for each job and check deliveries against the order
- Frame walls and floors for remodels and additions
- Read plans and lay out the work before cutting
- Work with the owner and crew to keep each job on schedule
slots.jd.remodeling.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of carpentry experience, including framing and stair building
- Concrete forming and door and window installation skills
- Blueprint reading and accurate layout
- Jobsite safety knowledge and steady work habits
- Apprenticeship Completion Certificate (required)
- Lead Carpenter Certificate (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Build forms for concrete using layout and measuring to set lines and grades, cutting rework on pours by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Check plans and measure each wall before cutting finish trim, so joints fit tight on the first install.
slots.r1.b3: Order lumber and materials for door and window installation from plan takeoffs, reducing material waste by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Frame walls and floors to plan, using blueprint reading to place openings, beams and joists correctly.
slots.r1.i1: Works as a journeyman carpenter at Wren Valley Builders, keeping the jobsite safe and orderly for the crew while carrying out carpentry work.
slots.r1.i2: Handles carpentry for Wren Valley Builders as a journeyman, reading plans and taking measurements to set out each job before work starts.
slots.r2.b1: Kept the site safe by following jobsite safety practices and clearing hazards daily, reducing safety incidents on the crew by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Installed doors, windows and trim and supported concrete forming for footings and steps under journeyman direction.
slots.r2.b3: Built forms for concrete and assisted with cabinet installation, cutting form setup time by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Read plans and measured work areas to plan scaffold erection, setting scaffolds at the right height and position for each task.
slots.r2.i1: Served as an apprentice carpenter at Copperfield Construction, learning to read plans and take accurate measurements under journeyman guidance.
slots.r2.i2: Worked as an apprentice carpenter at Copperfield Construction, installing doors, windows and trim alongside experienced carpenters.
slots.summary.1: Journeyman carpenter with 4 years of experience completing carpentry work to code without close supervision. Skilled in cabinet installation, layout and measuring, and jobsite safety, backed by an apprenticeship certificate in carpentry.
slots.summary.2: Carpenter at journeyman level with about 4 years on job sites, working independently and building to code. Brings hands-on experience in layout and measuring, cabinet installation and jobsite safety from apprenticeship through journeyman work.
